reviews.title: Slick Design, Ram Clearance, and Good Cooling
reviews.comment:
I waited on getting an air cooler for a long time due to a few things: Ram clearance, height clearance, aesthetics, and price. My PC is custom-built by another company, with the parts handpicked by me. While I picked my parts based on friends' recommendations and a general gist of what I personally needed, after three years, I went into looking for an air cooler for easier maintenance and long-term reliability. I have a mid-case tower, and my RAM sticks are way too high for the big chonky air coolers on the market, and I wasn't going to spend more money just to get better clearance of 32 GB of RAM. That would be a total waste, and after some research, I stumbled upon this brand.
I was replacing a 120mm AIO (which I know is essentially pointless unless you lack space or airflow), so finding this air cooler that not only is perfect for my RAM clearance, but also meets my height clearance too. I'm thankful this air cooler doesn't have those annoying nubs at the top, because I don't think I would've met my height clearance otherwise. The design is super slick too, which makes my PC build look real nice, so that's a bonus. I'm using this to cool an AMD Ryzen™ 7 5700G, which is a low TDP CPU of 65W, so the cooler will do its job well.
The cooler and fans are well made, and installation was a breeze. The fans runs my PC cool with little to low noise if you adjust the fan curve. It depends on the time of year and where you live, but since I live in a cooler area, my idle temperature sits nicely at 30C and during some gaming sessions with Chrome and Discord in the background, between 47-55C. However, I do have other fans installed for more optimized airflow, so other people’s results will vary. The price is just right, and certainly beats similar air coolers that go over $100 for the same performance. I highly recommend this air cooler if you're looking for RAM clearance, decent CPU cooling, height clearance for mid-sized towers, and a slick design to boot.

reviews.title: Perfect replacement. A million times better than the one that the PC came with .
reviews.comment:
Perfect replacement for my PC, the original one was way underpowered and burnt out in less than a year. This is at least double the fan power which is needed for an i7.
It's a little bit difficult to put inwhen you get to the wire holders part, but it's a simple procedure I just don't have nimble hands.
The video to replace was 1000% spot on.
It's not as quiet as the original one but again the original one wasn't powerful enough. But it's still quiet. Also this one doesn't have the cables for all the novelty lights that the other one had, but in my opinion I'd rather have it work than have lights on it.
Also it does come with the gell for the CPU. Which I didn't know so I had bought my own.
